# Daily Briefing – Friday 3 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no recorded activity and just 4,154 steps, though your body nearly matched your 2,300 kcal target at 2,288 burned, which is solid for a rest day. The main flag is sleep at only 5.5 hours; that's below where you want to be for consistent recovery and weight progress.

The good news is your HRV sits at 103ms — within your baseline range — and your resting HR of 48bpm with a stress score of 28 suggests your body is genuinely recovered. Today's planned session can go ahead as normal. Don't let the low step count yesterday guilt you into overdoing it though.

Tonight, prioritise getting 7-8 hours sleep above everything else. Poor sleep directly blunts fat metabolism and protein synthesis — both critical for hitting that 80-85kg target. Phones off by 10pm.
